name: Portal Jumper

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Choose Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant Resistance. Once per turn, spend 15 feet of movement to teleport to a visible empty space within 15 feet. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
